entities.summary: Pauli Ernesti Blomstedt, more commonly known as P. E. Blomstedt, was a Finnish architect and designer, who worked first in the Nordic Classicism style and then turned to Functionalism. His father, Yrjö Blomstedt, and younger brother, Aulis Blomstedt, were also well-known architects.
